steps.eyebrow: A LINK IS ALL IT TAKES.
steps.title: Your next shared moment
steps.subtitle: starts with three steps.
steps.open.body: Open the website or desktop app and choose a display name so others recognize you.
steps.room.title: Meet in the same room
steps.room.body: Agree on a room ID or share a room link or QR code. Add a room password when needed.
steps.share.title: Start something together
steps.share.body: Send a file, make a call or share a screen. Once your devices are online together, you're ready to share.
privacy.title: You decide what to share.
privacy.body: Messages, files, audio and video travel over WebRTC. The signaling service stores no chat history or files. History and cached files stay on your device; you manage shared files and remote access.
privacy.note: Connections depend on network conditions. When a direct connection is unavailable, TURN can relay encrypted traffic.
faq.title: Before you connect,
faq.subtitle: a few useful answers.
faq.account.question: Do I need an account or an installation?
faq.account.answer: The web version requires neither an account nor a native app. Open the page, choose a display name and join the same room as the other person. To allow remote control of your Windows PC, run the desktop client on that PC.
faq.devices.question: Can phones and computers work together?
faq.devices.answer: Yes. Phone browsers, computer browsers and the Windows app can join the same room to chat and transfer files. Camera access, screen capture, clipboard and notifications depend on your device, browser and permissions.
faq.storage.question: Where are files and chat history stored?
faq.storage.answer: Chat history, cached files and preferences are stored locally in the current browser or desktop app. The signaling server stores no chat history or files. Browser and desktop storage are separate and do not sync automatically. Clearing site data also removes local history; save important files separately.
faq.offline.question: Can I receive messages or download files after someone goes offline?
faq.offline.answer: Sending messages and downloading shared files from another device requires both parties to stay connected. Room messages reach only members currently online; the server does not deliver offline messages. Fully received content saved locally remains available in your local file library.
faq.control.question: Can someone control my computer without asking?
faq.control.answer: Remote control requires approval on the host or a match with an allow rule you previously saved. You can deny requests, manage permissions and revoke control locally at any time. Windows display sharing supports control; window sharing is view-only. Clipboard sync and remote file drop are off by default.
